README: PGM3 2026 build data. Upload this file at the start of a new session. All staff research is complete; only post-cut rosters and draft boards remain.

TB.dc_note: Bowles calls the defense; Edwards is pass game coordinator, senior defensive voice

draft2027_note: 289 prospects. Ranks 1-100 = NFL Mock Draft Database consensus board (aggregates 31 analyst boards, 122 mock drafts), updated 2026-08-24. Ranks 101-300 = Drafttek preseason Top 450, updated 2026-08-17. 11 duplicates removed where the sources overlap. Two boards stitched together, so the seam around rank 100 is approximate - fine for a draft pool where relative order is what matters. Drafttek position labels were normalized (DL1T/DL3T/DL5T->DL, ILB/OLB->LB, CBN->CB, WRS->WR, OG/OC->IOL). pos_raw is the source label; position is mapped to PGM3.
draft2028_note: ONLY 32 PROSPECTS, AND LOW CONFIDENCE. Source is Brad Menendez 32-player first-round projection at NFL Draft Countdown, published 2026-05-04 - a MOCK DRAFT ORDER, not a big board, and the source says its team order was randomized. Treat rank as rough ordering only. No genuine overall 2028 big board existed as of late Aug 2026: the consensus board aggregates 1 mock, Tankathon lists 2028 names alphabetically without ranks, WalterFootball has 197 players but only in separate positional lists with no overall order. Schools reflect the May source and may be stale - transfers move fast this far out. RECOMMENDATION: use these 32 as the top of the 2028 class and generate the rest, or re-check for a real board closer to the season.
draft_potential_note: For historical builds, prospect potential came from what the player actually became (career AV, Pro Bowls, All-Pros, years started). That is impossible for 2027+. Potential must come from board rank instead, which means no hidden gems and no busts - the draft reflects consensus opinion. Worth mentioning in the Reddit post.
